set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set forwarding-options sampling input ra.explanation: Configure the input rate for sampling.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.explanation: Sample rate, in the number of packages per second.

set forwarding-options sampling input ru.explanation: Configure the length of the sampling input.

parameters.name: run-length
parameters.explanation: Sampling runs for length, indicating the number of packages sampled continuously.

set forwarding-options sampling input ma.explanation: Configure the maximum number of packages per second for sampling.

set forwarding-options sampling family i.explanation: The command configures the IP address (`[parameter1]`) of the flow server to which sampled traffic data is sent for analysis in Junos.

port [parameter2].explanation: The command `port [parameter2]` in Junos specifies the physical port or interface to which the configuration or operation applies, using the value provided in `[parameter2]`.

parameters.name: port
parameters.explanation: The port number of the flow server.
